title: The Story of Bilal ibn Rabah and Patience in the Face of Harm

text_simplified: The text refers to the story of Bilal ibn Rabah, may Allah be pleased with him, where he endured torture because of his faith in Allah. His stance demonstrates his patience and steadfastness upon the *aqeedah* (creed) despite the pain. Parents can use this story to reinforce the values of patience and steadfastness in their children.

review_defects.arabic: يُظهر الموقف صبره وثباته على العقيدة رغم الألم.
review_defects.english: His stance demonstrates his patience and steadfastness upon the *aqeedah* (creed) despite the pain.
review_defects.why: The Arabic subject is 'الموقف' (the situation/incident), not 'His stance'. The English changes the subject, altering the meaning from 'the situation shows his patience' to 'his stance demonstrates his patience'.
